summary: Iteration 7 regression + new key/coin visuals verified. Backend pytest: 17/17 passing. Frontend web preview: 0 page errors across intro -> menu (menu-coins, menu-keys, menu-best, menu-play-button all render) -> Oyna -> HUD (hud-score, hud-coins w/ CoinIcon, hud-distance) -> crash -> game-over-sheet (game-over-score, game-over-coins with CoinIcon glyph + count, game-over-retry-button, game-over-home-button, Yeni Rekor badge). Pause flow: hud-pause-button -> pause-sheet -> pause-settings-button is a round 60x60 icon-only button (no label), navigates to /settings, settings-close-button returns to pause-sheet, pause-resume-button resumes play. settings-adfree-card contains '50 anahtar' welcome-pack copy. Key pickup system reviewed in /app/frontend/src/game/engine.ts: nextKeyAt=rand(1200,2200), spawnRow sets keyPending when distance>=nextKeyAt and calls placeKey(freeLane, z+22), collectKeys emits 'key' event + increments runKeys + emitHud; HudState.keys is wired to hud-keys pill in Hud.tsx (shown only when keys>0); 'key' event triggers profileRef.current.addKeys(1) in app/index.tsx; profile.addKeys persists to storage so menu-keys reflects next launch. Could not keep a run alive >1200 m via headless keyboard automation (crashed at 41 m) but static code path for key spawn/collect/HUD/profile is intact and consistent.

test_evidence.key_logic_review: engine.ts:134 nextKeyAt=rand(1200,2200); engine.ts:583-588 pending flag + placeKey(freeLane, z+22) + reschedule rand(1500,2500); engine.ts:661-673 collectKeys emits 'key', increments runKeys, release+emitHud; Hud.tsx:36 renders hud-keys pill when hud.keys>0; index.tsx:91 'key' event triggers profile.addKeys(1); profile.tsx:276-281 addKeys clamps & persists.

critical_code_review_comments: engine.ts placeKey uses `z + 22` where z is the current row's negative Z. This places the key ~22 units closer to the player than the spawning row, i.e. still ahead of the runner but ahead of the player horizon only when distance has grown enough. The first key (nextKeyAt 1200-2200 m) therefore spawns well after the first few rows — consistent with spec.

CoinIcon.tsx double-ring glyph (outer colors.brandTertiary with colors.brandTertiaryShade border, inner concentric ring) renders consistently in hud-coins and game-over-coins pills; visually matches the in-world gold coin mesh.

pause-settings-button uses ChunkyButton with round=true + size='lg' + icon='settings-sharp' and no label -> renders as a bordered 60x60 circular icon button; verified via bounding box and empty text_content.
profile.setAdFree welcome-pack logic (profile.tsx:309-320) is guarded by welcome_pack_granted storage flag so a second subscription will not re-grant 50 keys — correct one-time semantics.
seed_data_creation: Backend pytest regenerated TEST_A1 -> TEST_A1b and TEST_B1 players (ids ephemeral per run; see pytest_results.xml).

To verify a live key pickup end-to-end, either (a) temporarily lower nextKeyAt bounds for a debug build, or (b) add a dev-only cheat/testID that forces placeKey. Current web preview flows all verified: menu/HUD/crash/revive/game-over/retry/pause/settings/adfree/resume. All testIDs listed in iteration_6 remain valid; add hud-keys (pill with key icon + count, visible only when runKeys>0).
